title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 103
paragraphs: Now from the Maeotian lake to the river Phasis and the land of the Colchians is a journey of thirty days for one without baggage; and from Colchis it is not far to cross over into Media, for there is only one nation between them, the Saspeirians, and passing by this nation you are in Media. The Scythians, however, did not make their invasion by this route, but turned aside from it to take the upper road, which is much longer, keeping Mount Caucasus on their right hand. Then the Medes fought with the Scythians, and having been defeated in the battle they lost their power, and the Scythians obtained rule over all Asia.
